Resumen del fútbol.

How Frank can restore reputation and save Crystal Palace.
Will Thomas Frank rebuild his reputation at Crystal Palace after a bruising time in charge of Tottenham?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Has Trafford replaced Pickford as England No 1?.
James Trafford was given a chance to stake his claim as England's new number one - and away to the world champions, he absolutely took it.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Klopp says Infantino worse than Blatter.
Germany manager Jurgen Klopp says he "didn't think things could get worse after Sepp Blatter, but someone has managed to do just that" as he calls for Fifa president Gianni Infantino to be replaced.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Cap fits as Robertson poised to take King Kenny's crown.
Andy Robertson will take over from Kenny Dalglish as Scotland's most-capped player when he captains his country against Switzerland on Monday evening.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Belgium's Lukaku retires from internationals.
Romelu Lukaku retires from international football, saying he has "enjoyed every single moment" of playing for Belgium.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Burnham urges caution on scrapping 3pm TV blackout.
Andy Burnham urges caution on lifting the Saturday 3pm TV blackout in the UK, saying the health of the football pyramid should come first.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Republic of Ireland captain Collins to miss Kosovo game.
Republic of Ireland captain Nathan Collins is ruled out of Tuesday's must-win Nations League game against Kosovo with a knee injury.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

60 minutes of perfection, 30 minutes of chaos - an England win for the ages.
England's stunning win in Spain had everything - and was their best under Thomas Tuchel, writes Phil McNulty.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

How did England cling on against Spain and what did Tuchel do differently?.
Trying to protect a lead in the closing stages, England have been here before - so how did they cling on against Spain?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Is Scotland's system limiting Gannon-Doak's threat?.
As Scotland prepare to conclude their Nations League group campaign in Switzerland, there are concerns about how new head coach Sebastien Pocognoli is utilising one of his most exciting assets.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
